title: Smock
summary: SMOCK, noun 1. A shift; a chemise; a woman's under garment. 2. In composition, it is used for female, or what relates to women; as smock-treason. SMOCK'-FACED, adjective [smock and face.] Pace faced;

inlines.v: SMOCK, noun 1. A shift; a chemise; a woman's under garment. 2. In composition, it is used for female, or what relates to women; as smock-treason. SMOCK'-FACED, adjective [smock and face.] Pace faced; maidenly; having a feminine countenance or complexion. SMOCK'-FROCK, noun [smock and frock.] A gaberdine.
